text:
Most service businesses don't lose customers. They get forgotten.

A salon client who came every 5 weeks stops coming. She's not unhappy. Another salon simply reminded her first.

The fix is a rebook timer per service:
• Haircut: 4-5 weeks
• Facial: 4 weeks
• Colour touch-up: 6 weeks

When the timer hits, one message with two slots: "Saturday 11 am or 4 pm?" Two options get more replies than "let us know when you're free".

The same idea works for car service (km/date), clinics (follow-up), pharmacies (monthly refill) and gyms (renewal).

Which repeat purchase in your business has no reminder today?

#customerretention #smallbusiness #automation
